description: USE THIS for "free camping near <town>", "dispersed camping near" or "boondocking near" a US town (national forest and BLM records we hold; if we hold none it says so). Up to 5 free camps within 25 straight-line miles, nearest first, each with cost evidence, water, nearest toilet, the season reading for today, its record URL, and what is unrecorded. Also gives the site's page for that town when one exists.
